name: gizza-ai/hash-text
summary: Hash text with a selectable algorithm (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-2/SHA-3/BLAKE)

tool.description: Compute a cryptographic hash of text with a selectable algorithm. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256 (default), SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-512, BLAKE2b-512, BLAKE2s-256, and BLAKE3. By default the input is hashed as UTF-8 text and the digest is returned as lowercase hex; set input_encoding='hex' or 'base64' to decode the input first, output_format='base64' for a base64 digest, or uppercase=true for uppercase hex. To hash a whole FILE, use the file-hash tool.

uppercase.description: Emit uppercase hex (no effect on base64). Default false.
